title: Charlotte FC forward Patrick Agyemang named to MLS All-Star team - NewsBreak
text:
CHARLOTTE, N.C. (CAROLINA SPORTS LIVE) – Charlotte FC forward Patrick Agyemang is an MLS All-Star, the league announced Wednesday, becoming The Crown’s first-ever player selected for the showcase.
Agyemang was one of Commissioner Don Garber’s selections for the match that will be played on July 23 in Austin, Texas, against the Liga MX’s All-Stars. The 24-year-old is one of seven players currently competing with the United States Men’s National Team in the 2025 Gold Cup to be named an MLS All-Star. Drafted in 2023, the striker has scored eight goals in 2025 across all competitions for Charlotte FC, while adding an additional five for the U.S. Men’s National Team. Agyemang earned his first national team call up in January of 2025. The game will be broadcast live on MLS Season Pass on Apple TV.
